including any AWS accounts that are assigned
values.spoken: the console for their assigned accounts

claim: IAM Identity Center gives employees single sign-on from an existing identity provider to user-facing AWS applications and to the AWS Management Console, including the AWS accounts assigned to them.

evidence.quote: IAM Identity Center helps you configure the single sign-on experience of your employees from your existing identity provider to user-facing AWS applications, such as Amazon Q and Amazon SageMaker AI, and to the AWS Management Console, including any AWS accounts that are assigned to your employees.
evidence.title: Choosing an AWS identity service
